request: Windows在build中启动新编好的程序之前总会受到之前未关闭导致启动失败的问题
initial_status: Clean main at baseline 298a728860a5c2ebaf9699500a35b184b1881975 before this task; four scoped files now modified during this task.
acceptance: Windows desktop startup records its own PID and process creation time only after obtaining the per-installation single-instance mutex.
Build bootstrap sends WM_CLOSE to the tracked instance, keeps retrying while startup has not created its window yet, and waits for the tracked process handle to exit before replacing the launcher.
If the instance cannot exit (including an unresolved unsaved-edit dialog), bootstrap fails with actionable text and leaves the prior launcher intact; no force-kill is used.
Windows native build and regression evidence confirm both the startup race and normal graceful-close paths.

requirements.summary: 记录用户报告的 Windows build 旧桌面实例未退出导致新程序启动失败；集中 Issue #812 已创建。

design.summary: 桌面子进程在处理启动参数后、服务健康检查前，先获取本安装单实例 mutex 并登记 PID/创建时间；构建端按状态收据获取进程句柄，重试 WM_CLOSE 并有界等待。旧版本没有收据时，按安装目录派生窗口类名并短暂等待窗口出现。
evidence: Inspected scripts/windows-bootstrap.bat, native/windows-launcher/main.cpp desktop-stop/build flow, Desktop::run, and Windows desktop architecture docs.

implementation.summary: 新增启动早期单实例锁和桌面 PID/创建时间收据；构建端对已登记进程持续请求正常关闭并等待实际退出，旧版本无收据时兼容按窗口关闭。超时明确保留旧程序。
